narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL3__M6B53B18 reveals significant optimization opportunities.

- The material exhibits a smooth demand pattern with CV of 0.41
- Mean daily demand: 110.9 units with 77.6% non-zero days
- A statistically significant declining trend detected (slope=-0.1810, p=0.0228)
- Distribution type: normal

LEAD TIME CHARACTERISTICS:
- Mean lead time: 0.76 days (CV: 1.20)
- Lead time stability: unstable
- Effective lead time (mean + 1σ): 1.68 days
- Lead Time Variability is the dominant factor (85.2% of variance)

RECOMMENDED POLICY:
- Safety stock: 182 units (currently 0)
- Reorder point: 267 units
- Order quantity: 1116 units (currently ~36)
- Review period: 11 days

COST IMPACT:
- Current SAP policy total annual cost: $38,535.50
- Optimized policy total annual cost: $2,611.40
- Annual savings: $35,924.10 (93.2%)

The optimization achieves a 93.2% cost reduction by balancing ordering frequency with holding costs,
while maintaining 95% service level through appropriate safety stock.
